name: dubai_changing_bgcolors
title: Dubai skyline, changing background colors
description: Mono 360° equirectangular panorama of a Dubai skyline at sunset; the background sky is animated through a wide hue/chroma range. Worst-case for static-label methods that pick a single farthest color — the CEC sweeps.

label_region.note: Rectangular 'entering' label in the lower-left region of the equirectangular frame. Binary PNG; foreground pixels (>127) are the label area. The Unity AR scene renders this panorama as stereo at runtime; the label is drawn once on the panorama and the runtime stereo view then shows it in both eyes.

source_original: data/scenes/dubai_marina_timelapse/ (YouTube fTfJwzRsE-w); this video is a 15s nighttime snippet of that source with an animated background hue cycle added.
